stayWindow.selectionRule: Choose the first option that explicitly guarantees the early check-in window, private-bath AC rooms for five adults, and a total group quote that fits the budget. Do not rely on standard check-in times.

callChecklist: Five adults for the night of 15 Sep, checking out morning of 16 Sep.
Can you GUARANTEE room access between 08:00 and 09:00 on 15 Sep, and what is the early-check-in charge?
Quote the total including taxes for the cheapest practical room combination for five adults.
Confirm every booked room has AC, a private bathroom and hot water.
Can you hold five backpacks before check-in if needed, and after checkout until about 04:30 on 17 Sep?
If holding bags overnight after checkout, confirm the front desk will physically release them at 04:30.

stays.name: Hotel Parklane · Dadar East
stays.address: 5th Floor, Hind Rajasthan Building, 95 Dadasaheb Phalke Marg, Dadar East, Mumbai 400014
stays.stationAccess: About a 2-minute walk from Dadar Central railway station according to its current hotel listing.
stays.earlyCheckIn: Not guaranteed publicly. 24-hour front desk is listed; call and require written/clear confirmation for 08:00–09:00.
stays.priceNote: Budget property. Nearby-date online prices were materially below the better-rated Dadar options, but the 15 Sep five-adult total must be quoted directly.
stays.why: Almost eliminates the station-to-hotel transfer after collecting bags and makes checkout-to-storage on 16 Sep walkable.
stays.watch: Do not book unless early check-in is guaranteed; standard check-in is noon.

stays.name: Hotel Avon Ruby · Dadar East
stays.address: 87, Naigaon Cross Road, Dadar East, Mumbai 400014
stays.stationAccess: Roughly a 7-minute walk from Dadar station in current hotel listings.
stays.earlyCheckIn: Early check-in is referenced by a current booking listing and may carry an extra charge; exact 08:00–09:00 access remains subject to direct confirmation.
stays.priceNote: A current Sep 15–17 search showed roughly ₹4.7k per night for two adults before group/room-combination differences.
stays.why: 24-hour front desk, baggage storage and a short station walk make it the strongest fallback if Parklane will not guarantee the morning room.
stays.watch: Standard check-in is after noon, so an early-access promise is still mandatory.

stays.name: Kohinoor Lodge · Dadar East
stays.address: Kohinoor Bhavan, Swami Gyanjivandasji Road, opposite Dadar Central Railway Station, Dadar East, Mumbai 400014
stays.stationAccess: Opposite the Dadar Central station complex; current hotel listings describe it as roughly an 8-minute walk depending on the entrance used.
stays.earlyCheckIn: No reliable public guarantee found. Call the property reservation number and require explicit confirmation.
stays.priceNote: Officially positioned as a budget lodge; live Sep 15 group pricing was not consistently published, so call direct.
stays.why: Very low transfer effort and direct official reservation contacts make it a useful last-resort stay if the first two fail.
stays.watch: Recent review summaries are materially weaker, especially around room/bathroom quality. Insist on AC rooms with private bathrooms before paying.

luggage.principle: Keep Dadar as the luggage hub. Avoid carrying bags to Lalbaug, Siddhivinayak, Uran or South Mumbai.

options.name: Dadar Railway cloak room
options.cost: Use the station's current prescribed tariff; do not rely on old online rates.
options.rules: Railway guidance says cloak rooms are for genuine rail passengers, require photo ID, and accept securely locked/neatly packed luggage.
options.use: Primary for 14→15. For 16→17 use it only if 04:30 retrieval is explicitly confirmed before the trip.
options.watch: A reliable current public source for Dadar's exact overnight/04:30 collection hours was not found.

options.name: Chosen hotel's baggage hold
options.contact: Use the selected hotel's direct phone
options.cost: Ask whether it is complimentary for booked guests.
options.rules: Get explicit permission for five backpacks and a named pickup time.
options.use: Potentially the cleanest 16→17 solution if the hotel will release bags at 04:30; all shortlisted stays are close to Dadar.
options.watch: Do not assume a 24-hour front desk automatically means overnight luggage release is allowed.

options.name: Lugsto · Dadar fallback
options.cost: Lugsto currently states roughly ₹50–₹120 per bag for the first day depending on location.
options.rules: Book online; the exact partner address and hours are supplied with the booking. Photo ID is required.
options.use: Fallback for Dadar storage when the railway cloak room cannot be used.
options.watch: Support is listed 07:00–23:00; verify the actual partner's pickup hours before using it for any early-morning retrieval.

2026-09-14: Bandra Terminus → Dadar: take one direct cab with the backpacks. A local-train option adds an unnecessary transfer from Bandra Terminus to Bandra local station.
Dadar storage → Lalbaug: use a short taxi hop. If Lalbaug is abandoned, go directly to Siddhivinayak rather than returning to Dadar first.
Late night → Uran: pre-book the Danda Beach road ride and, ideally, the return pickup. This is the trip's one deliberately long transfer.
2026-09-15: Danda Beach → Dadar: use the pre-arranged return ride, collect bags once, then walk to the selected Dadar East hotel.
Protect the hotel recovery block; do not insert sightseeing between bag collection and check-in.
Hotel → Siddhivinayak by short taxi. If Lalbaug is the fallback instead, go hotel → Lalbaug directly. Explore outward from that anchor and make only one return to the hotel at night.
2026-09-16: Checkout → luggage hold: walk to the chosen hotel hold or Dadar cloak room; no cab should be needed if the stay shortlist is used.
Dadar → Sea Lounge: use the Western local to Churchgate, then a short taxi or walk to the Taj area. With no luggage this is cheaper and less traffic-sensitive than a road trip from Dadar.
After Sea Lounge keep the rest of the day geographically in South Mumbai rather than returning north and coming south again.
2026-09-17: Late night: bias the final exploration northward. Once local-train service becomes inconvenient, use one cab back to Dadar rather than hopping between areas.
Reach the bag pickup point around 04:30, then go straight to the platform buffer for the 05:52 train.
